reader_summary.overview: Baroness Dambisa Moyo is a global economist, author, board member, and investor who sits at the intersection of public policy, corporate governance, and capital allocation. House of Lords, sits on the boards of Chevron, Starbucks, Condé Nast, and Oxford University's investment committee, is Chair of the Economic Club of New York. Our conversation traces Dambisa's journey from growing up in Zambia to becoming a leading voice on global economic development and governance.

key_points.text: House of Lords, sits on the boards of Chevron, Starbucks, Condé Nast, and Oxford University's investment committee.
We discuss how her experiences across more than 80 countries and on the boards of four global companies shaped her judgment on economic growth.
We then turn to the application of those lessons at Altered Trajectory, including the evolution away from an endowment-style portfolio.
